selection_objective: mean MDP seven-class log loss on inner OOF; tie prefers earlier candidate
head_features: 18 B2 pilot features plus 7 frozen preoutcome OEH probabilities; separate fit per core learner; no family-label feature
head_capacity_note: joint: 7x200 output trees; two-stage: 1x200 binary plus 6x200 conditional output trees, nominal 1400 each; not equal wall-clock or proof of equal effective capacity
conditional_bounds_note: one-sided max-t over 12 comparisons on cached MDP OOF scores; exploratory, does not include refitting uncertainty or historical reuse
additional_stress_test: leave one MDP family out; repeat inner grouped selection only on the training families; descriptive scores separate from grouped CV contrasts
adoption: no replacement of frozen candidate or promotion to confirmatory GO
